rules.statement: The court's discretion to order security for costs under section 416 of the Civil Procedure Code should be exercised judicially and with reason, and the amount ordered should also be reasonable.
rules.supporting_quote: (1) The discretion of the court to order security for costs of the defendant under section 416 of the Civil Procedure Code should be exercised judicially and with reason; and the amount ordered should itself be reasonable. (2) Section 416 provides for "security" which is required to be furnished, in order to create a fund from which an order for costs made by the court could be satisfied, if such costs are not directly paid by the plaintiff. "Incurred" costs under the section means that amount of costs which the court may financially award, regardless of what the party may actually spend. (3) In making the order the court should not be unduly influenced by the view that the plaintiff did not have a prirna facie case or the absence of a valuation report annexed to the plaint.
